mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchants ( account_code, status, currency, is_auto_captured, is_auto_settled, platform_fee_fixed, platform_fee_bps, profile ) VALUES ( #{accountCode}, #{status}, #{currency}, #{isAutoCaptured}, #{isAutoSettled}, #{platformFeeFixed}, #{platformFeeBps}, CAST(#{profile} AS jsonb) ) ON CONFLICT (account_code) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO sellers (account_code, merchant_code, status) VALUES (#{accountCode}, #{merchantCode}, #{status})
INSERT INTO ledger_accounts (account_code, ledger_type, owner_code, seller_code, currency, status) VALUES (#{accountCode}, #{ledgerType}, #{ownerCode}, #{sellerCode}, #{currency}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT account_code, status, currency, is_auto_captured, is_auto_settled, platform_fee_fixed, platform_fee_bps, profile::text AS profile FROM merchants WHERE account_code = #{accountCode}
